project.title: Space Invaders
project.description: Classic-inspired Space Invaders: 40 marching invaders, shields and bombs. LEFT/RIGHT to move, A to fire.
project.author: PRG32 Kit

fields.TEXT: Space Invaders: 40 invaders march down; A fires the laser cannon.
Mode 0 = title, 1 = playing, 2 = game over.
Playing: cannon, laser, fleet, bombs, then the end-of-wave checks.
The cannon: LEFT and RIGHT move it, A fires one laser at a time.
The laser flies up; it can hit an invader or a shield.
Which invader is the laser inside? Each one sits in a 24 x 18 cell.

fields.COND: laser_x >= fleet_x && laser_y >= fleet_y && col < 8 && row < 5 && (laser_x - fleet_x) % 24 < 16 && (laser_y - fleet_y) % 18 < 16

fields.TEXT: Shields: 4 shields x 6 blocks, each block 8 x 6 pixels with 3 hit points.
The fleet marches faster when fewer invaders are left.
Invader bombs: up to 3 at a time, dropped by the lowest invader of a random column.
Bombs fall; they can hit a shield or the cannon.
Shields: 4 shields x 6 blocks, each block 8 x 6 pixels with 3 hit points.
If the invaders reach the ground, the game is over.
Find the lowest row that still has an invader.
All invaders gone: a new, lower wave starts.
Show the score in the PRG32 status band.
